content_of_post_to_comment: We’ll think more clearly about when it’s ok to use AI once we realize that most of the issues don’t have to do with AI at all. When asking “Is it ok to use AI to fact-check?” or “Is it ok to use AI to brainstorm ideas?” or “Is it ok to use AI to write my Substack for me?”, just replace “AI” with “a really smart and helpful person”. (And so the answers are obvious: yes, yes, and no.) Some people talk as if these issues are brand new, but they’ve been around ever since God created research assistants, editors, and spouses.
comment: The deeper question may be less about whether AI replaces help, and more about where we draw the line between assistance that sharpens thinking and assistance that substitutes for it.
